---
title: "Felix Salmon and the Unbearable Lightness of Nouriel"
date: "2007-03-10"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

[Felix Salmon](http://www.felixsalmon.com/000729.html "Felix Salmon") resorts to the Seinfeld defence in discussing Chairman Roubini’s latest piece of doom-mongering:

> *it generally asserts at least as much as it argues, and is written more colloquially than formally.  Not that there’s anything wrong with that.*
